_comment: Central registry of all data.gov.in datasets used by PRAMAAN.
_comment2: UUID = index_name from the API response. active=false means UUID is unverified/wrong — skip fetch.
_how_to_find_uuid: Go to data.gov.in → search dataset → open API tab → copy the UUID from the URL or response index_name field.
